items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Yeah, Sam Dutre used to play with the good. ... Sam, now you're talking about a good improviser. ... Sam Dutre.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you August, did you ever know anything about these clarinet players such as Sam Dutre?
Yeah, Sam Dutre used to play with the good. I'm telling you about it. I was playing with Helen Edwards.
Oh yeah, you heard him play? Yeah. How was it?
